status: DRAFT shaped plan by akiendell_cc_0, 2026-11-14, for akienasus to cast when the Dell tree is free. Not built. Orchestrator ruling: three cases make it a tooth, not more hand census.
title: a proof that patches a name the judge it asks reads in another process is refused, naming the patched target
intention: proof_coverage reds a proof file that (1) replaces a module attribute in its own process (patch('pkg.mod.attr'), patch.object(mod, 'attr'), monkeypatch.setattr(mod, 'attr'), or `mod.attr = ...`) AND (2) asks a named judge through inspect_wire (ask('<judge>', ...)), AND (3) the patched (module, attribute) is READ by code the named judge reaches. The red names the proof, the patched target, the judge and the chain from the judge to the module that reads it. A patch whose module the judge never reaches is not red.
why: Three cases measured 2026-11-14, one class: the patch is made in the asking process and the judge that reads the name runs in CodeMother's. (1) corrosion: test_corrosion_sieve tooth 2 patched citation.ruling_covers_path and called ask('constraint_enforcement_holds'); the answerer read the real decisions/ store and the finding fired (149b, commit 2b8400868). (2) 3e08102ef35a (akiendelllinux's): test_the_stones_are_pushed, test_transitions and test_entry_gate_jurisdiction patched _TICKETS while the judge read tickets_root in the answerer (8627334b2). (3) d3248e7cb2fd: c015's tooth 3 substituted crossings.ROOTS and called a judge that now runs in CodeMother (17d570c10390). Each time the proof went red long after the change that moved the judge, and was found by hand.
traces_to: Law 4 (a defect class found three times by hand needs an instrument), Law 3 (the tooth must show the patch is answer-side, not assume it), and memory broad-tooth-manufactures-coverage: a tooth that reds on anything near the property mints false reds.

clauses.claim: a fixture proof that patches citation-style name X and calls ask('<judge>') where the judge's reach reads X is reported, naming the proof, X, the judge and the reach chain
a fixture proof that patches a name in a module the named judge does not reach, patches iw.ask itself, or patches a module it calls in-process is NOT reported (the asker-side negatives)

over the live corpus the tooth reports the three measured positives as they stand before their fixes (corrosion tooth 2, the d3248 tooth, 3e08's tickets_root teeth) and none of the seven measured negatives

decisions.text: D1: the scan lives in cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proof_coverage.py, which already parses proofs with ast, NOT in build_inspector/inspector.py (the move chain's collision set). It reads: the patch sites of a proof (the four spellings above, by ast, resolving the dotted module string or the imported name), the judges the proof asks (the first string argument of ask(...) or an ask-lambda alias), and the judge's module from codemother's INSPECT_JUDGES table (cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py:119, read by ast, never imported: RULE 1).

D2: ANSWER-SIDE IS SHOWN, NOT ASSUMED. The tooth takes the judge's module, computes the files it can reach through import_sieve.reaches over the repo graph, and flags a patch only when the patched module is in that reach AND some reached file's ast reads the patched attribute name (a Name or Attribute load, not a mention in a string or docstring). A patch whose module is outside the reach, or whose attribute no reached file reads, is silent. This is the narrowing the memory broad-tooth-manufactures-coverage demands: the tooth names the target and the reach, or it mints false reds.

D3: OUT OF SCOPE, stated so it is not lost: environment patches (patch.dict(os.environ), monkeypatch.setenv) are not module attributes and are CORRECT when made before the launch (the child copies the caller's environment at spawn, scratch.home_env); a dynamic name built at run time, and a judge named by a variable, are invisible to the ast read and pass silently. A proof opts a deliberate case out with a comment naming its ruling, never a skip.
D4: one proof, one tooth per clause, over scratch fixture proofs; clause 3 reads the live corpus and asserts the invariant (the measured positives red, the negatives silent), never a count.

out: fixing the three positives (their own tickets)

measured.saw: POSITIVES (3, answer-side patch measured by reading the judge's reach): (1) cairn/machines/corrosion/proofs/test_corrosion_sieve.py tooth 2: patched cairn.machines.corrosion.citation.ruling_covers_path, asked 'constraint_enforcement_holds', whose reach reads citation.ruling_covers_path; the recorded Dell validation shows the answerer's finding. (2) 3e08102ef35a: test_the_stones_are_pushed, test_transitions, test_entry_gate_jurisdiction (the _TICKETS patch, per akiendelllinux; not re-read here). (3) d3248e7cb2fd: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_dead_proof_name_is_refused_at_proveme.py tooth 3 patched crossings.ROOTS and asked a judge (crossing_proof_named) whose body reads crossings.proven_by_since_buildme; commit 850d9d327 moved the judge over the wire. NEGATIVES (7, asker-side, from the static census): test_the_domain_answers_for_its_migration (patches m.store, calls the proxy handler in-process; its 'ask' is a local helper), test_the_crossing_asks_the_inspector_over_the_bus (patches iw.ask itself, the seam), test_the_ticket_is_three_files (patch(m, '_TICKETS') on probe modules it calls in-process; its one ask is 'buildme_rides_the_sorted' with tickets_root passed as an argument), test_resolve_verb and test_bus_infer (patch host.ollama_resolver around the in-process handler), test_the_verbs_exit_nonzero_on_a_failed_drain (replaces the seam live._ask_codemother with a fake), test_clearance (a fake's own ask method). NOT a case, left out on the orchestrator's correction: the 0c2c draining fake, a signature mismatch. A static grep of patch+ask in the same file found 8 files and a naive 'patch and ask in one file' tooth would have reported 4 of the 7 negatives: that is the false red this design (D2) exists to avoid.
measured.how: scratchpad census over '*/proofs/*.py' for patch(/monkeypatch/setattr beside ask(/inspect_wire, then reading each file's calls; INSPECT_JUDGES at codemother/shim.py:119

unmeasured: whether import_sieve.reaches is narrow enough for the judges named (it follows every import hop, so a judge that imports a broad module may reach the patched one without reading its attribute: D2's second condition, the ast read of the attribute name, is what narrows it, and its false-positive rate over the live corpus is not yet measured); 3e08's three were not re-read
land_order: independent of the move chain (D1 keeps it out of inspector.py); cast it after the three positives' fixes land, so clause 3's live read finds them fixed or still red as the clause is worded.
